setup: one agent per paper, each given only its own manuscript at a neutral path, told to read nothing else and not to search; never told a known answer existed or how many errors to expect
model: claude-opus-5 (Opus 5), no per-agent override, effort level xhigh; verified from the session subagent transcripts, not from memory
headline: 6/11 found the gold error unaided (7/11 counting the partial); paper 9 re-tested 2026-09-24 under a prompt naming no error class and matched again

3.note: paper 7 timed out and is excluded

leakage_check: no report showed signs of having read the gold; several argued against the referee's stated fix
caveats: paper 7 has never produced a scored result: two attempts hit the 64k output ceiling and a third stalled. It is excluded from every denominator.
no error here has been verified by a qualified human; every card still carries human_severity_label unreviewed
all agents were the same model at the same effort, so this run measures papers and error types, not model capability
the 2026-09-24 re-run read the current papers.txt, rebuilt after the anonymisation fix; paper 9 was not one of the two papers that file changed
prompts: prompts/referee-agent.md (canonical), prompts/referee-agent-reruns.md (the two variants and the disclosure)

hint_contamination.what: papers 7 and 9 were relaunched after crashing on the 64k output ceiling; both relaunch prompts added a clause naming the class of that paper's own gold error (dimensions for 7, coefficients for 9)
hint_contamination.tested: 2026-09-24, paper 9 re-run under the canonical prompt plus the length cap and no error-class clause
hint_contamination.outcome: MATCH again, at high confidence, argued from gauge invariance. The hint did not carry the result, so paper 9 stays in the count.
hint_contamination.paper_7: still unresolved: two output-ceiling crashes and one watchdog stall, no completed attempt
